title: Core card of one unit booked from–to v1
description: Carries a choice only: which unit. Its pictures, amenities, price and free days are the company's live records, read each time the page is (ADR-072, slice 5e).

unit.description: The unit (its id) the card shows — one the company shows its guests.

main.description: The card is the page's own heading: set on the unit's own page, which nobody edits.
